intro: One translation add-on, one Streamer.bot action. Choose Manual, Automatic, or Both; results always return only to the platform where the message originated.

sections.title: 1. Choose how translation works
sections.description: Manual is the safest starting point. Both adds privacy-gated automatic translation.

sections.title: 2. Provider and languages
sections.description: The easy no-key option can detect the source language. The documented provider needs a fixed source language.
sections.notice: Recommended for easiest setup: Google web + source auto + target en. Google web is an undocumented consumer endpoint and may change without notice. MyMemory is documented but cannot use auto.

sections.title: 3. Manual commands
sections.description: !translate buenos dias uses the default output language. !translate fr hello and !fr hello override it.

sections.title: 4. Automatic translation
sections.description: Start with approved viewers only. Commands, bots, system messages, simulations, duplicates, and ignored viewers are always skipped.

sections.title: 5. Limits and spam protection
sections.description: These bounds protect Streamer.bot, the provider, and public chat.

sections.title: 6. Voice translation
sections.description: Translate what you say for viewers who ask. Uses your Live Captions speech (Streamer.bot Voice Control dictation), so Live Captions must be on. Each option has its own switch.
sections.notice: Your speech is batched: one translation per language per window, so chat is not flooded. Spoken text stays in memory for two minutes and is never saved. For on-screen captions, add http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay/addons/thsv.user-translate as a browser source.

sections.title: 6b. Bilingual captions
sections.description: Your words on screen with a translation underneath, like subtitles on Japanese streams. Add the Translate overlay as a browser source; Live Captions must be on.

sections.title: 7. Voice commands and timing
sections.description: Commands viewers type, and how long each option runs.

sections.title: 8. Voice messages
sections.description: What chat sees for each voice option.

sections.title: 9. Stream Deck button
sections.description: Press once and talk: when you pause, what you said is sent. You can also press again to send right away. One translated message per language goes to each chat below. Put the Streamer.bot action THSV Addon - Translate - Push to Talk on a Stream Deck button (no approval needed). Its pushToTalkAction argument is toggle; use start and stop for separate buttons. Each button can also set pushToTalkOutput (chat, captions or both) pushToTalkPlatforms (for example youtube or twitch,kick) and pushToTalkLanguages (for example es or es,ja); left empty, the settings here apply.

sections.title: 9. Privacy review
sections.description: Translation cannot remain completely local with these providers.
sections.notice: Only eligible public chat text is sent over HTTPS. StreamBridge keeps only request tracking and cooldown timing, never the original or translated messages. The provider may process text and request metadata. Never submit private or sensitive information.
